title: K5 probe-covariance gauge-vs-physical orientation audit
interpretation_policy: A pass localizes fixed-spectrum orientation freedom: it is invisible to isotropic probe ensembles but becomes measurable relative to an anisotropic physical probe covariance. This does not establish that any spin-foam observable realizes the surrogate probe covariance.
scope_guard: Linearized Gaussian K5 surrogate only; does not close D7 or NEW_REQUIRED and is not a physical EPRL/Toller i-epsilon derivation.
